extracted.name: Buddha Bowl
extracted.description: Easy Buddha Bowls layered with whole grains, roasted veggies, falafel, and Jalapeño Ranch dressing.
ingredient_lines: 1 ½ cups quinoa (, brown rice, couscous, or cauliflower rice)
5 cups baby spinach leaves (, or arugula)
12 Falafel balls* (or 2 grilled chicken breasts, salmon, or other protein)
1/2 cup chopped walnuts, pecans, almonds, pine nuts or pistachios etc
1 small fresh jalapeño pepper (, ribs and seeds removed)
instruction_lines: Preheat oven to 425 degrees F. Add sweet potatoes to a sheet pan and drizzle with a little olive oil, salt and pepper. Roast for 20-25 minutes, until tender, tossing once while cooking.
Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Layer bowls with cooked quinoa, arugula, sweet potato, tomato, avocado, falafel or chicken, feta and nuts. Top with dressing.
categories: How to make a buddha bowl
